import sympy as sp

alpha = sp.symbols('alpha', real=True)

def answer(alpha):
    r"""
    Return the expression of the derivative $g(\alpha)$ in Sympy format

    Inputs
    ----------
    alpha: sympy.Symbol, real parameter, $\alpha \in [0, 1]$

    Outputs
    ----------
    g_alpha:  sympy.Expr, $g(\alpha)$ for $\alpha \in [0, 1]$.
    """

    # ------------------ FILL IN YOUR RESULTS BELOW ------------------
    g_alpha = sp.log(1+alpha) - alpha/(1+alpha)**3 * ( sp.hyper([sp.Rational(3,2), 2], [3, 2], alpha*4/(1+alpha)**2) + sp.Rational(1,2)*sp.hyper([sp.Rational(3,2), 2], [3, 2], alpha*4/(1+alpha)**2) )
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------

    return g_alpha
